title: The Ghost Convoy Manifest
logline: A private logistics hauler carrying surplus wartime frequency dampers across regional gates is ambushed by veteran privateers, exposing that the military officially declared the cargo destroyed a decade ago to pocket casualty insurance.

roles.description: A veteran commercial purser carrying a sealed cargo across three systems; nervous, practical, and in over his head.
Former naval privateer who recognizes the cargo containers from an escort mission he was supposed to have perished in.
A ruthless administrative officer dispatched to ensure old wartime manifests stay buried.
A nimble raider scout gunboat screening the privateer flotilla and tracking engine wakes.
A heavily modified surplus gunboat with patched armor plates and overclocked prow cannons.
A cavernous logistics staging platform orbiting a crossroads star system.
A rust-streaked free port in an unpatrolled outer rim system.
A network of retired officers and suppliers who privatized naval logistics during the postwar drawdown.

public_situation: A heavily laden freight hauler jumps across regional gates under escort, drawing unwanted attention from privateers claiming the shipment is stolen naval property.
private_truth: The convoy's military dampers were declared lost with all hands during a wartime ambush ten years ago, allowing high-ranking officers to collect insurance while warehousing the hardware for private sale.

beats.public_change: A regional freight hauler docks at the provincial depot under emergency priority clearance, requesting heavy defensive escorts.

missions.reason: He hires an independent pilot to carry sealed manifest cylinders to the depot harbormaster before gate clearance expires.
missions.private_fact: The manifests list the dampers under false agricultural serial codes to evade gate tariff registries.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to purchase high-grade coolant canisters needed to keep the container refrigeration systems from cooking the hardware.
missions.private_fact: If the coolant drops, the container seals will melt and release registered military tracking signals.

beats.public_change: The convoy jumps into the neighboring system, where corsair scouts immediately lock tractor beacons onto the hauler's wake.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to intercept and destroy the trailing corsair scout picket before it can relay the freighter's jump coordinates.
missions.private_fact: The scout captain hailed claiming the freighter is flying under an expired wartime naval registry.

beats.public_change: The fleet auditor arrives in system aboard an unmarked cutter, demanding custody of the cargo under wartime emergency clauses.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to scan the container seals at the scrap station to verify the original naval casualty docket against official archives.
missions.private_fact: He wants the fraud exposed because his brother was listed as missing in action on the very convoy that officially died carrying this cargo.

beats.public_change: Military cartel gunboats close in on the frontier scrap station to scuttle the freight hauler and silence all witnesses.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to clear the jump lane past the corsair cordon so the freighter can escape into deep space.
missions.private_fact: The corsair commander hails mid-flight offering to share the proceeds of the stolen military dampers if the pilot helps force the freighter to dock at the scrap station.

player_choice.prompt: With the fighting suspended around the frontier scrap station, the pilot must decide whose hands receive the ghost convoy.

options.label: Deliver the cargo to the fleet auditor to bury the wartime casualty fraud
Turn the freighter over to the veteran corsairs to avenge their lost comrades
Release the original casualty logs to public data relays

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot allies with the corsairs and diverts the hauler to the frontier scrap station.
resolutions.summary: {role:veteran_corsair} seizes the hardware and distributes the proceeds among families of the ghost convoy's fallen crew. {role:fleet_auditor} flees the system.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped naval veterans hijack a ghost convoy full of military parts written off a decade ago.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot defends the freighter and turns the cargo over to the fleet auditor.
resolutions.summary: {role:fleet_auditor} secures the ghost manifest and buries the shipment in an offshore naval depot. The fraudulent insurance payout remains unbroken.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot escorted a ghost shipment past corsairs, burying evidence of wartime naval fraud.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the authentic wartime manifest across regional communications networks.
resolutions.summary: The public learns that high-ranking officers faked the loss of an entire naval convoy for profit. {role:military_cartel} faces military trials across three systems.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot released encrypted logs proving military officers stole a convoy they reported destroyed.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the convoy.
resolutions.summary: Corsair gunboats overrun the freighter in unpatrolled space. {role:hauler_supercargo} is stranded in an escape pod while the military parts disappear into black markets.

loose_threads.detail: The shipping dockets include an indemnity bond issued by a private banking cartel with terms tied to wartime casualty payouts.
The corsair frigate's hull plating still displays a faint naval service crest identical to the one stamped on the freight containers.

radio_hooks: Unscheduled military freight transit causes jump gate delays across three star systems.
Regional logistics board denies rumors of ghost ships operating under expired naval charters.
Veteran advocacy groups demand parliamentary audit of wartime transport loss records.

voice_direction.hauler_supercargo: Speaks in a rapid, sweaty, defensive rattle, frequently checking manifests and muttering under his breath. Terrified of gate inspections.
voice_direction.veteran_corsair: Deep, gravelly, and deliberate, speaking with the cold formality of a court-martial officer. Never swears.
voice_direction.fleet_auditor: Chilly, immaculate, and speaks in chillingly calm bureaucratic circumlocutions. Never acknowledges a weapon is present.

title: The Neutral Relay Siege
logline: An independent orbital communications curator who maintained strict neutrality during a dock dispute is besieged by both factions seeking the unedited transmission logs that would incriminate their rivals.

roles.description: Keeper of the station's unencrypted historical comms buoy; stubborn, idealistic, and terrified of taking sides.
Leader of the freight handlers' union who insists the relay logs will prove management opened fire first.
Corporate station security chief determined to seize and sanitize the logs before they reach the system tribunal.
An armed tugboat outfitted with bolted-on armor plate and industrial cutting lasers.
An isolated solar-powered antenna spar anchored three hundred kilometers off the main station ring.
A militant coalition of dockworkers, loader pilots, and crane technicians.

public_situation: An armed standoff erupts around the neutral communications relay buoy off {system} after deadly clashes between striking dockworkers and corporate security.
private_truth: The relay curator possesses raw, unedited optical footage showing both the union militia and corporate guards opening fire at the exact same moment during the riot.

beats.public_change: Both union picketers and corporate security gunboats scramble towards the isolated communications relay outpost.

missions.reason: He needs an independent pilot to dock at the relay spar and retrieve the physical optical storage core before either faction's ships dock.
missions.private_fact: He knows that whichever side gets the drive will selectively edit the footage to claim victimhood and escalate the war.

beats.public_change: Corporate gunboats declare an exclusion zone around the relay buoy, threatening to fire on any ship leaving the sector.

missions.reason: She hires an outside pilot to scan the relay transmitter to certify whether any unredacted footage has already been beamed off-system.
missions.private_fact: If any unredacted footage left the station, her corporate board has already authorized her to liquidate the entire relay facility.

beats.public_change: A union gunboat blocks the transit lane to the main habitat concourse, demanding the pilot hand over the memory core.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to disable or drive off the union vessel so the unedited logs can be safely transported to an independent judicial courier.
missions.private_fact: His vow of strict journalistic neutrality is costing him his sanity as both former friends now treat him as a traitor.

beats.public_change: Security patrols and armed union freighters prepare for a full-scale battle outside the orbital judicial airlock.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to escort her shuttle to the relay bay to demand the curator release the union casualty footage.
missions.private_fact: The corporate security director hails mid-flight offering a massive bounty and station immunity if the pilot hands over the core to be erased.

player_choice.prompt: With both factions at a knife's edge and the optical core in hand, the pilot must decide who receives the unvarnished truth.

options.label: Broadcast the unedited footage to every radio receiver in the system
Hand the memory core to the union to fuel their rebellion
Destroy the core and protect the curator's neutrality from both sides

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the raw telemetry across the system.
resolutions.summary: The unedited footage reveals that both sides fired simultaneously. Outraged citizens force a ceasefire, though both factions despise {role:relay_curator} for exposing them.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broadcast raw footage proving both sides started the bloody dock riots.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot hands the footage to the strike captain.
resolutions.summary: {role:strike_captain} selectively edits the footage to show security aggression, sparking an armed general strike that shuts down all freight traffic in {system}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot delivered riot footage to the dock strike, fueling an armed station insurrection.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts corporate security's bounty and destroys the core.
resolutions.summary: {role:security_director} purges the records, exonerating security guards. The strike is crushed under martial law while {role:relay_curator} is driven into exile.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot sold the only riot footage to station security, breaking the dockworkers' strike.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the core and extracts the curator.
resolutions.summary: With the physical evidence pulverized, neither faction can claim legitimacy. {role:relay_curator} maintains his neutral vow but loses his ancestral station post.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot crushed an optical memory core to keep rival militias from twisting the historical record.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the relay.
resolutions.summary: Security forces storm the relay spar, destroying the antennas and arresting {role:relay_curator}. The unredacted truth is lost forever.

loose_threads.detail: The relay's telemetry transmission log shows an encrypted secondary stream directed towards an offshore intelligence vessel.
The rifles carried by the union picket carry serial numbers traced to a corporate security depot inventory write-off.

radio_hooks: Independent relay spar outside {system} surrounded by rival armed cutters following dock clash.
Station security issues ultimatum to communications curator demanding unedited incident logs.
Freight union leadership accuses management of manufacturing communications blackout.

voice_direction.relay_curator: Fastidious, tremulous, and constantly cites archival bylaws. Becomes shrill and desperate when pressured to take a side.
voice_direction.strike_captain: Hoarse, passionate, and blunt. Uses rough dockyard vernacular and treats anyone who hesitates as an enemy.
voice_direction.security_director: Crisp, measured, and patronizing. Uses polite corporate phrasing to deliver lethal threats.
